title: Spaceship Hosting Review 2026: Prices, Promo Codes and AI Builder
excerpt: Spaceship hosting starts at $19.88 for the first year, with a 30-day free trial. Here is what you pay at renewal, which promo codes are on its page and what is still unproven.

meta._yoast_wpseo_title: Spaceship Hosting Review 2026: Prices, Promo Code
meta._yoast_wpseo_metadesc: Spaceship hosting review for 2026: shared plan prices and renewals, the 30-day trial, promo codes for domains, AI website builder, pros and cons.
meta.rl_answer: Spaceship is cheap and simple, with a 30-day trial. We found no independent test of its speed or uptime.
meta.rl_faqs:
Is Spaceship hosting good? | It is cheap and simple, but we found no independent speed or uptime test with a method.
How much does Spaceship hosting cost? | Essential is $19.88 for the first year and $28.88 a year at renewal.
Is there a Spaceship promo code? | Its sale page lists COM67 for a .com at $3.60 for the first year, for new registrations.
Does Spaceship have a free trial? | Yes. It lists a 30-day free trial on shared hosting.
Does Spaceship have an AI website builder? | Yes. It lists an AI Website Builder, and WordPress AI tools on Pro and Supreme.
meta.rl_takeaways:
Essential is $19.88 for the first year and $28.88 at renewal.
A 30-day free trial is listed.
Promo codes on the sale page are for new domain registrations.
No independent test with a method was found.
meta.rl_g_glossary:
Shared hosting | Many sites share one server.
Promo code | A short code that applies a discount.
AI website builder | A tool that builds a site from a prompt.
Renewal | The price after the first term.
